tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: What this company sells, who it is for, and every agent/API entry point. No account needed.

tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD (monthly/yearly/one-time). No account needed.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Opens a Stripe Checkout Session for one plan and returns its cs_live_ URL. Nothing is charged until the buyer pays. Plans: tickvault_slice, tickvault_history, tickvault_history_year, fidelity_audit_once, fidelity_audit_pack. Without a plan, or if checkout is unavailable, returns the pricing page URL

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find pages on this site by keyword; returns url, title and summary.
